# Pradeep Biswal

> Poetry, books, memoirs and photographs from Pradeep Biswal, a poet writing in Odia and English, translator, and editor of Kabita Live.

The linked HTML pages are the canonical sources. Article text is available without JavaScript. Reader comments are moderated visitor contributions, separate from the author’s writing.
